scope: Directly compiled injector policy helpers; owned local files, data-only self exports and authoritative self-token queries. No target injection, runtime loading, graphics, desktop input or games.
cases: Strict architecture-specific leaf grammar and malformed fields
Build-ID and advertised eight-byte SHA-256 prefix binding
Unique NAME and stock wildcard filename disable rules, including the fixed reserved EGO filename
Known SHA-256 vector, full equal/changed file hashes, held deny-write/delete guards, missing/empty/directory/actual-symlink rejection and cleanup
Independent authoritative self-token privilege oracle and missing/non-process target rejection
Actual self module/export inspection distinguishes dormant member and completed adapter
sourceConfigureGuard: The foreign-host loading predicate admits (ready || adapter_ready) when the owned late-host capability is absent.

compatibilityScope.readyMeaningUnchanged: The new injector accepts baseline AdapterReadyV1=1 without fabricating authenticated MemberReady/ReadyV1.
compatibilityScope.manualStockHostLimit: An older injector requiring member readiness may time out on a manually configured stock-only host while every preloaded app is offline/dormant.
compatibilityScope.currentSdkScope: The SDK preloads only the latest project-owned hosts, whose existing gate/adapter-readiness path supports older SDK joins. Universal older-injector admission on manually configured stock hosts is not claimed.

warnings: The included injector retains pre-existing C4457 variable shadowing outside this feature.
retainedEarlierAttempt: Both initial executions reached token checks, then failed an incorrect fixture assumption that INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE was not a process handle. Windows uses the same -1 value as the current-process pseudo-handle. The fixture now uses an actual owned event handle of the wrong object type; no production guard was relaxed.
limits: This does not prove remote activation, dormant scanner loading, route isolation, hook recovery, rendering, input or foreign-installation preservation.
The measured thunk sizes are from these helper fixtures. Standalone injectors must enforce their own compiled-size checks and controlled loader acceptance.
The source hash identifies this exact draft; later build-ID or injector changes require separately identified candidate evidence.
